changelog:
JSON, MissionCompanion and SDK UPDATE REQUIRED!
- NEW DESTINATION SLOTS. Slots are no longer shared (Except Miami and Yacht, for now). Formerly shared slots have their alerted/difficulty and VR bricks enabled where possible. You can remove ANY destination from the campaign book pool by emptying all variants from them on the variant picker website (MissionCompanion only). But all extra destinations must have their SMF option turned on too to show up in game (All on by default except Hantu Port).
- Hawke’s Bay: Before The Host – New variant.
- Hawke’s Bay: All variants – Hard difficulty brick is no longer baked into any version, it now only applies on alerted. Previous update’s fix of camera grid going through floors and walls undone as consequence. VR Bricks now included in Peacock Plugin.
- Marrakesh: AHBOS – Shisha Cafe Safe no longer clips through stool, can no longer blend in ‘cleaning’ the CCTV laptop. Improves MANY suspect acts (unable to test them all), Bodyguard should no longer search forever for Kong and is no longer a target, Rooftop safe tablet no longer buried inside couch, man no longer stands awkwardly watching school forever (Vanilla Issue), makes him and others targets
- Sapienza: Alerted – Removes camera from broken graveyard fence. Now only appears in The Author (instead of there being two)
- Sapienza: Methlab – De Santis’ bodyguard should no longer search the map for her
- Chongqing: ETs – Removes bad freelancer target from ICA Facility
- Haven Island: Non-vanilla – Removes pedestal fan blocking access to safe in security room (Vanilla issue)
- Colorado: The Vector – Bradley Paine should no longer try to escape, unsure about others
- Berlin: Easter – Beer bottle no longer floats that man drinks out of
- Dartmoor: The Harbinger – Switches the ET’s pistol to one that does not require DLC ownership, preventing inventory being wiped if you take it and do not own DLC
- Isle of Sgail: The Disruptor – The Disruptor should no longer have deformed bones (vanilla issue, Thanks Luka), but he is still a hideous beast
- FV should no longer affect Holiday Hoarders mission lighting (But Random ToDs still will)
- Safehouse: Fixes crash on loading caused by oddity in modding tools (Will fix all mods that affect Safehouse)
